question: Do published positive-signalling/listening biases learn usable communication in the original MNIST-sum task under a bounded local reconstruction?
contract: Two independent image policies; discrete 20-symbol channel; listener has 19 sum actions; only sampled shared reward trains task policies; labels used for reward/evaluation only.
strongest_control: Same initial seed and image-pair sequence; no-bias learner and within-checkpoint shuffled-channel and zero-channel evaluation.
competing_explanation: Reconstruction choices or bounded optimization may prevent learning; a failed gate is not evidence against Eccles et al.
falsification: Fail the external learning gate unless all both-bias seeds exceed 0.2 validation sampled reward and beat shuffled messages.
adoption: Only passing checkpoints support later deadline diagnostics; no new method or paper-score reproduction claim.
continuation: All arms and seeds advance to 6000 only if any both-bias seed fails validation at3000; no test-based selection.
